target: 100% completion of the chosen classic Windows route, spoiler-free

areas.name: Route and Save Setup
areas.location_cue: The Windows launcher, mode selectors, costume menu, and save directory.
areas.note: Primary route: classic Windows PC; no secondary platform pass.

levels.1: Confirm the classic version before creating completion data.
levels.2: Install the GOG or Steam classic Windows release.
levels.3: Launch Resident Evil 3: Nemesis (1999) from GOG or Steam and keep its save folder separate from the 2020 remake. Confirm costume selection and The Mercenaries appear at the PC menu.

levels.1: Several clears and purchases must remain on one continuing file.
levels.2: Back up the save folder before every ending branch and reward purchase.
levels.3: Close the game, copy the save directory to a dated folder, and label difficulty, route choices, clear count, epilogues, and Mercenaries purchases. Restore files only while cloud synchronization is closed.

levels.1: The full reward chain exists only on the harder setting.
levels.2: Create the primary completion file on Heavy.
levels.3: Start Heavy with the default handgun and eight inventory spaces. Use this file for the seven-drop chain, S rank, ordered files, ending branches, eight epilogue clears, and purchased Mercenaries rewards.

levels.1: The assisted setting has a distinct loadout and dodge behavior.
levels.2: Finish one complete run on Light.
levels.3: Start Light, inspect its expanded weapon supply, automatic dodge, ten inventory spaces, and infinite ribbons, then finish once. Do not use this run for the pursuer drops or epilogue ledger.

levels.1: The PC release includes two regional rule families.
levels.2: Finish one Heavy run under Original and one under Arrange.
levels.3: Select Original Heavy for one full clear, then repeat under Arrange Heavy. Record their enemy resilience and regional rule differences separately; do not confuse these with the 2020 remake.

save_backup.title: Back up the continuing file
save_backup.why: Eight clears, branches, and shop purchases share completion data.

areas.name: Live Selection Matrix
areas.location_cue: Timed prompts across the station, downtown, cable car, tower, park, and factory.
areas.note: SAVE-BACKUP: record both choices and timeout at every prompt.

levels.1: A timed prompt can change rooms, supplies, or later mechanics.
levels.2: At the fight outside or enter the station.
levels.3: Keep a save before the courtyard prompt. Record fighting outside, entering the station, and allowing the timer to expire; each changes the immediate pursuit and item opportunity.

levels.1: A timed prompt can change rooms, supplies, or later mechanics.
levels.2: At the use the basement or hide in the kitchen.
levels.3: Visit the Restaurant before the Press Office, save before meeting the other survivor, then record basement, kitchen, and timeout. The kitchen route creates a Heavy-mode drop opportunity.

levels.1: A timed prompt can change rooms, supplies, or later mechanics.
levels.2: At the jump through the window or hide in back.
levels.3: On another run visit the Press Office first. Record the window, rear hiding place, and timeout; the hiding route creates the corresponding Heavy-mode drop opportunity.

levels.1: A timed prompt can change rooms, supplies, or later mechanics.
levels.2: At the raise electrical output or use the emergency exit.
levels.3: Back up before the control-room breach. Record increased output, emergency exit, and timeout, then note whether the next pursuer encounter moves to the entrance or later alley.

levels.1: A timed prompt can change rooms, supplies, or later mechanics.
levels.2: At the climb upward or jump into the opening.
levels.3: After collecting the oil additive, save before the garage collapse. Record climbing, jumping, and timeout; jumping exposes a short underground passage before returning to the street.

levels.1: A timed prompt can change rooms, supplies, or later mechanics.
levels.2: At the jump from the window or operate the emergency brake.
levels.3: Back up before repairing the car. Record both choices and timeout because the Clock Tower entrance, supplies, and later room state change.

levels.1: A timed prompt can change rooms, supplies, or later mechanics.
levels.2: At the use the light or connect the cord.
levels.3: Save before the balcony prompt. The light avoids a later chase but forfeits this drop; the cord creates an immediate knockdown and lets Heavy collect reward six.

levels.1: A timed prompt can change rooms, supplies, or later mechanics.
levels.2: At the push the pursuer away or jump from the bridge.
levels.3: Keep the park bridge save permanently. Record push, jump, and timeout; timeout follows the jump route with damage. These branches select different factory entrances and ending mechanics.

levels.1: A timed prompt can change rooms, supplies, or later mechanics.
levels.2: At the negotiate by radio or return fire.
levels.3: Reach this prompt from the jump-or-timeout bridge branch. Record negotiation, direct return fire, and timeout on separate saves before continuing to the final machinery.

levels.1: A timed prompt can change rooms, supplies, or later mechanics.
levels.2: At the finish the remaining threat or evacuate.
levels.3: Back up after the final machinery activates. Record both displayed choices and timeout; this changes only the last physical encounter, not the already selected rescue route.

save_backup.title: Keep a save before every prompt
save_backup.why: Choices alter rooms, supplies, drops, and ending mechanics.

areas.note: Earn S and understand every category used to calculate it.

levels.1: Three result categories contribute equally to the final grade.
levels.2: Finish with at least 270 total ranking points.
levels.3: Target a combined 270 across time, saves, and restored health. The clean maximum is under 2:30, zero saves, and no more than 1,500 health restored; any other category combination reaching 270 also awards S.

levels.1: The first scoring band ends just before two and a half hours.
levels.2: Finish by 2:29:59 for 100 time points.
levels.3: Plan room splits around 2:29:59 or faster. At 2:30 the time category falls to 90, then continues declining through later fixed bands; compensate elsewhere if the run crosses a boundary.

levels.1: Every typewriter use lowers one result category.
levels.2: Use zero typewriter saves for 100 save points.
levels.3: A run with no typewriter use earns 100 in the save category; one save earns 90 and two earn 80. A clear-data write after the result does not belong to the completed run.

levels.1: The game totals restored health rather than counting item names.
levels.2: Restore no more than 1,500 health for 100 recovery points.
levels.3: Track actual health restored across herbs and sprays. Stay at or below 1,500 for 100 points; full-heal items add up quickly, so avoid healing when only slightly injured during the S-rank run.

levels.1: Combine the full reward route with the top result when practical.
levels.2: Earn S on Heavy without abandoning the seven-drop completion data.
levels.3: Use a dedicated Heavy branch, collect only drops compatible with the time target, avoid typewriters, and limit recovery. Finish at 270 or more, save the result, and preserve it separately from slower file and route-variant clears.

areas.name: Heavy Drop Chain
areas.location_cue: Seven rewardable pursuit encounters from the station courtyard through the ruined tower.
areas.note: SAVE-BACKUP: every case advances a fixed chain, and one balcony choice can forfeit case six.

levels.1: Only a full knockdown at a rewardable encounter produces the next case.
levels.2: Defeat the pursuer at the police courtyard and collect drop #1.
levels.3: On Heavy, fully incapacitate the pursuer at rewardable encounter 1 in the police courtyard, wait for the item case, and take EAGLE Parts A. Skipped encounters do not reset the chain; the next case advances its fixed reward number.

levels.1: Only a full knockdown at a rewardable encounter produces the next case.
levels.2: Defeat the pursuer at the west stairway and collect drop #2.
levels.3: On Heavy, fully incapacitate the pursuer at rewardable encounter 2 in the west stairway, wait for the item case, and take EAGLE Parts B. Skipped encounters do not reset the chain; the next case advances its fixed reward number.

levels.1: Only a full knockdown at a rewardable encounter produces the next case.
levels.2: Defeat the pursuer at the Restaurant or Press and collect drop #3.
levels.3: On Heavy, fully incapacitate the pursuer at rewardable encounter 3 in the Restaurant or Press, wait for the item case, and take First Aid Box. Skipped encounters do not reset the chain; the next case advances its fixed reward number.

levels.1: Only a full knockdown at a rewardable encounter produces the next case.
levels.2: Defeat the pursuer at the Sub Station or Forked Alley and collect drop #4.
levels.3: On Heavy, fully incapacitate the pursuer at rewardable encounter 4 in the Sub Station or Forked Alley, wait for the item case, and take M37 Parts A. Skipped encounters do not reset the chain; the next case advances its fixed reward number.

levels.1: Only a full knockdown at a rewardable encounter produces the next case.
levels.2: Defeat the pursuer at the Three Points Street and collect drop #5.
levels.3: On Heavy, fully incapacitate the pursuer at rewardable encounter 5 in the Three Points Street, wait for the item case, and take M37 Parts B. Skipped encounters do not reset the chain; the next case advances its fixed reward number.

levels.1: Only a full knockdown at a rewardable encounter produces the next case.
levels.2: Defeat the pursuer at the Clock Tower balcony and collect drop #6.

levels.1: Only a full knockdown at a rewardable encounter produces the next case.
levels.2: Defeat the pursuer at the ruined Clock Tower and collect drop #7.

levels.1: Two early cases form a unique handgun.
levels.2: Combine EAGLE Parts A and B.

levels.3: Load Next Game data after the rifle chain, remain on Heavy, and incapacitate the pursuer at all seven rewardable encounters. The seventh case now contains Infinite Bullets; apply it to a chosen compatible weapon only after backing up.
